handoff.summary: Cycle 4 (phase2-ui) completed T-006+T-007: M1 fully removed (src/core, src/protocol, src/setup.ts, old src/ui, 10 M1 test files, verify-visual.mjs) and the new UI built on src/domain only. src/ui now: App.tsx (shell: chain/network/global tabs, slot bar with +1 advance + next proposer, validator count 4-10 select that restarts the run, theme toggle), useSimulation.ts (states-per-slot array over advanceSlot — index=slot, ready-made rewind surface for T-010), modes/ChainMode.tsx (local via domain observe / god via state.{tree,votes,finality,heads}; status panel + LMD vote table), BlockTreeView.tsx (SVG: slot columns, J/F badges, head chips, vote chips, head-path emphasis), treeLayout.ts (deterministic DFS rows), validatorColor.ts, modes/{NetworkMode,GlobalMode}.tsx placeholders. Theme system (validated palette, light default, data-theme) salvaged from M1 in theme.ts/useTheme.ts/styles.css. README rewritten for the new design. Evidence green: typecheck 0, vitest 9 files/67 tests 0 (incl. tests/ui/appShell.test.tsx jsdom DOM tests + treeLayout tests), build 0. jsdom added as devDependency (npm install needs --cache "$TMPDIR/npm-cache" under the sandbox). Sandbox denies port listen and cdn.playwright.dev → real-browser smoke scripts/verify-ui.mjs (file://dist based) is ready but needs a human-run 'npx playwright install chromium' (R-001, non-blocking; jsdom covers the interactions). changed_files 50 ≥ reset threshold 25 — this handoff is written for a fresh session reading only the disk.
next_actions: T-008 (phase2-ui, cost 4): implement NetworkMode (per-validator at-a-glance grid: head/justified/finalized/last vote per validator, hover shows that validator's view — use domain observe(log, v, slot, count)) and GlobalMode (left: ChainMode tree, right: network grid). Replace the two placeholder components; reuse BlockTreeView for hover/detail. Extend tests/ui/appShell.test.tsx with DOM tests for both modes.

Then phase3: T-009 (interventions: compile intervention list into a Delivery rule + protocol overrides — engine already takes delivery as a parameter, do NOT redesign it; UI specifies partition/stop/equivocation/delay-drop at slot boundaries) and T-010 (rewind UI: useSimulation already keeps states[slot]; add a slot cursor that views past states — advancing from a past cursor should truncate-or-branch per T-011 scenario design).
UI must keep consuming ONLY src/domain exports (tests/domain/purity.test.ts enforces).

Essence gates to remember: (a) semantics changes of View/Vote/protocol skeleton and (b) large UI look/info-design pivots go back to the human. First-build discretion already used and recorded: SVG tree rendering, M1 palette salvage, jsdom verification layer.

Discretionary semantics on record: SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=4; same-slot equivocation resolved lexicographically; anchor slot 0 / first proposal slot 1; attestations of a slot simultaneous (votes visible through s-1).
R-001 (proposed, non-blocking): human may enable real-browser verification via 'npx playwright install chromium' once; until then jsdom DOM tests are the autonomous verification layer.
